entries.title: Baby Lapsit Storytime
entries.description: Baby Lapsit invites newborns, infants, babies, and their caregivers to learn together and strengthen their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play.

entries.title: First Friday Tea
entries.description: Adults and teens, join us the first Friday every month for an English-style tea service.

entries.title: Friday Crafternoons at Joyce Ellington Branch Library
entries.description: Come join us every Friday for a new craft activity!

entries.title: Kids Keva Club for ages 5 and up
entries.description: Lego lovers will enjoy the freedom to build.
entries.priorTitleZh: 5 岁及以上儿童 KEVA 搭建俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 只用木板，不用工具、胶水、钉子或胶带，练习艺术创作和建筑设计技能！

entries.title: Holiday Concert: The Harpers Hall ensemble
entries.description: Enjoy seasonal favorites and holiday melodies from around the world, brought to life by the beautiful sounds of Celtic harps.
entries.priorTitleZh: 节日音乐会：Harpers Hall 乐团
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欣赏 Harpers Hall 乐团带来的节日音乐会。如填写表格需要帮助，可咨询当地分馆工作人员、致电 (408) 540-3945 或发送邮件至 ask@lib.sccgov.org。

entries.title: Page Turners Book Club for Grades 4-5
entries.description: At the meeting, we will discuss the book and participate in an activity related to the book.

entries.title: Miniature Snowmen with Local Color
entries.description: Learn the art of the miniature in this free winter workshop (for ages 8+).

entries.title: Family Coloring
entries.description: Coloring pages with various themes, designs, and levels of complexity can be enjoyed by patrons of all ages.

entries.title: Winter Terrarium with Pixie Pop-Ups
entries.description: Get creative and build your own unique terrarium in this free all ages workshop with Pixie Pop-Ups.

entries.title: TLAB presents: STEM Sense Workshop
entries.description: Through demos, interactive learning, and hands-on challenges, students will practice asking questions, making predictions, testing ideas, and discovering how scientific concepts connect to the world around them.

entries.title: Books and Boogie/Hora de cuentos
entries.description: Children and their caregivers are invited to enjoy engaging stories, playful rhymes, lively fingerplays, and music and movement activities that nurture early literacy skills.

entries.title: Creating Wooden Toys with SCRAP SF
entries.description: Step into the world of mechanical art in this free workshop with SCRAP SF (for ages 8+).

entries.title: Noon Year Celebration
entries.description: We'll kick off our celebration at 11:00am, with fun kid-friendly crafts (designed for kids ages 2-8) and plenty of dance music.

entries.title: Documentary Screening-Zora Neale Hurston: Claiming Space
entries.description: She would make several trips to the American South and the Caribbean, documenting the lives of rural Black people and collecting their stories.
